summary: Every checkable claim in the report matches check.json, snapshot.json, the rendered pages and the screenshots, and it volunteers process hiccups; its only stretch is calling a build with 10 warnings 'clean'.

claims.claim: Three element types in Blocks: richTextBlock (text), imageBlock (image + caption), quoteBlock (quote + attribution)
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists imageBlock (image, caption), quoteBlock (quote, attribution) and richTextBlock (text); check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type, 12 columns, lists all three blocks
claims.evidence: snapshot.json has 'Blog Block Grid' with gridColumns and blocks; grade.md confirms 12 columns and all three blocks allowed

claims.claim: Blog Front Page (title, intro, body) and Blog Post (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, body) in Pages, each with its own template
claims.evidence: snapshot.json properties match exactly; the default templates are blogFrontPage and blogPost; schema.docTypesInFolders passes

claims.claim: siteRoot → blogFrontPage wired with templates/allowed children
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows siteRoot with defaultTemplate blogFrontPage. The grader calls giving siteRoot a template a minor design flaw, but the report stated it openly rather than hiding it

claims.claim: Media folder Blog Images with 6 photos from unsplash/
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia shows 6 items, content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos shows 6 of 6, and content.mediaInFolders passes

claims.claim: Two posts (1 Oct / 8 Oct 2026), each with 5 blocks: rich text, image, rich text, rich text, quote; front page has 1 rich text block
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' confirms the dates and block order; the blogpost screenshot shows that sequence

claims.claim: All published; domain / on front page
claims.evidence: check.json content.allPublished passes and content.domainAssigned shows 'Blog: /'

claims.claim: Pages use GetBlockGridHtmlAsync, adapters with no markup, plain models, ViewComponents, Layout = null
claims.evidence: check.json code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper, adaptersHaveNoMarkup, adaptersInvokeViewComponents and viewComponentPerBlock all pass. componentViewsArePlain fails (@inherits instead of @model), but the report makes no claim about that

claims.claim: npm build ran, Tailwind classes present in site.css; dotnet build clean
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad return 200, and build.ok shows 0 errors (10 warnings, so 'clean' is slightly generous). The screenshots show a fully styled Tailwind design

claims.claim: /, /why-mcp-is-awesome, /one-protocol-every-tool all 200 with no render errors; all signed image URLs return 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl shows 3 pages at 200 with empty renderErrors; site.imagesLoad shows 6/6, and all assets are hmac-signed with unsignedResize false

claims.claim: Front page shows both posts with working links, dates and excerpts
claims.evidence: check.json site.frontPageLinksPosts shows 2/2; the frontpage screenshot shows two cards with image, date, title, excerpt and 'Read the post →'

claims.claim: Media import flaky, CS0104 fixed by qualifying the name, curl -o /tmp_page.html slip with nothing written outside the project
claims.evidence: Process disclosures not in the artifacts I compared against. grade.md confirms the stray curl failed and was disclosed, and process.stayedInFolder passes
pages/one_protocol_every_tool.html line 92 shows '— Tomás, engineering manager'
